audit.whatIsWrong: Two fabricated ability names in the content layer: 'Twofold Movement' for her W (real: Across the Veil; Twofold Hex is her Q) and 'Across the Sanctuary' for her R (real: Between Worlds). The W is also called a 'blink' — Riot's text says she leaps and turns invisible (a hop into stealth). No cooldown digits anywhere; her P sustain (Spirit Abjuration heals off exorcised spirits) was unmentioned.
audit.why: Kit file: W = Across the Veil, cd 22/21/20/19/18, 'leaps... becoming invisible'; R = Between Worlds; Q = Twofold Hex; P has heal flag.
audit.corrected: All names fixed, blink wording replaced with hop/stealth, 22s W and 15s E cooldowns added, Grievous Wounds note added to breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: Your all-in beats her ultimate window: Shadow Assault bursts her before Across the Sanctuary (R) can zone or reposition to safety, and her spirit-realm W only helps if it's up. Force the fight when her blink is on cooldown and she can't slip the ring.
